meta.missing_data_rule: null means not measured — never treat it as passing or failing a preference

definitions.crime.per_km2: reported incidents (12 months) per km² of land; see crime_by_neighbourhood.json meta
definitions.parks.share_within_400m: share of H3 res-9 sample points within 400 m straight line of a park >= 0.5 acre
definitions.parks.park_land_share: share of the neighbourhood's land that is park
definitions.transit.share_within_800m_rail: share of sample points within 800 m of a BART/Caltrain/Muni Metro stop
definitions.transit.share_within_400m_frequent: share within 400 m of a stop with >= 120 weekday departures
definitions.cycling.dedicated_km_per_km2: protected + path + painted lane km per km² (each direction counted)
definitions.hills.median_slope_pct: length-weighted median 40 m DEM-derived street grade (percent); not surveyed
definitions.groceries.share_within_800m_supermarket: share of sample points within 800 m of an OSM supermarket
definitions.collisions.per_km2_per_year: injury crashes per km² per year (3-year window)
definitions.rents.typical_rent_zip_weighted: Zillow ZORI asking rent, area-weighted over overlapping ZIPs (ZIP-level!)
definitions.crime.per_1000_residents: reported incidents per 1,000 ACS residents; null if < 1,000 residents. Visitor/commuter-heavy areas read high
definitions.population.population: ACS 2020-2024 residents, tract populations apportioned by land area
definitions.population.median_gross_rent_popweighted: ACS median gross rent (rent PAID), population-weighted tract mean
definitions.environment.*_pctl: CalEnviroScreen 5.0 statewide percentile (100 = most burdened), population-weighted tract mean
definitions.food_drink: OSM cafes/restaurants/bars inside the neighbourhood - context only, not ranked
